headline: Morgan Stanley Maintains Overweight on Arthur J. Gallagher, Lowers Price Target to $240
summary: Morgan Stanley  analyst Bob Huang   maintains Arthur J. Gallagher (NYSE:AJG) with a Overweight and lowers the price target from $265 to $240.

headline: Arthur J. Gallagher & Co. Acquires McKee Risk Management, Inc.
summary: Arthur J. Gallagher & Co. today announced that its U.S. wholesale brokerage, binding authority and programs division, Risk Placement Services, Inc. (RPS), has acquired King of Prussia, Pennsylvania-based McKee Risk Management, Inc. Terms of the transaction were not disclosed.
